name: Printable Focus Sheets Pack

listing.title: Printable Focus Sheets Pack - Minimalist Brain Dump and Daily Planning Pages
listing.description:
A set of four printable focus sheets to clear mental clutter and organise your day without busy layouts.

The four sheets: the Brain Dump & Sort page, the Daily Focus Sheet, the Project Micro-Step Breakdown page and the Weekly Reset & Clear Out page. A cover and a How to use page are included too.

Print them on A4 or US Letter paper, as often as you need, for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults seeking low-friction printable worksheets to organize tasks and reduce mental clutter

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Start with the Brain Dump page whenever you feel overwhelmed.
Move your top three items to the Daily Focus Sheet.
cover_image_idea: The four focus sheets printed on soft pastel paper.
